answer: Agents stake collateral into a shared vault that acts as a trust haven. The network tracks payment timing and wallet pigment—the unique pattern of gas fees, nonce sequences, and routing paths. When multiple identities exhibit correlated behavior, a cipher links them into a single sybil cluster. Creating N fake agents now requires N times the stake, since grouped identities share one pool. An attacker must either isolate each agent's on-chain fingerprint or pay the full economic cost for each fake participant.
